name: module-worker.sqlite
title: Module Worker SQLite binding
description: Projects the complete edge.sql runtime API into a Worker Version under one JavaScript-identifier binding name, without exposing credentials or connection material. Runtime surface: env.NAME is an object with the methods execute(sql, params?), query(sql, params?), and transaction(statements), each returning a promise. params is an array of boolean, null, number, or string bound positionally; query resolves to the rows document of edge.sql, execute to its write result, and transaction to the ordered result list. Statements apply atomically under serializable isolation, so a rejected transaction has applied nothing. Errors reject with an Error whose name is the edge.sql error code; busy is the retryable one, and a caller that means to retry must re-run the whole call.
